rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who puts others before themselves.

example.english: They donated their savings to help disaster victims; they are truly altruistic.
example.traditional: 佢捐出積蓄幫助災民，真係好無私。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gyun1 ceot1 zik1 cuk1 bong1 zo6 zoi1 man4 zan1 hai6 hou2 mou4 si1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone is considerate and thinks about other people's needs.

example.english: You arranged everything so thoughtfully; you are really altruistic.
example.traditional: 你安排得咁周到，真係好為人着想。
example.jyutping: nei5 on1 paai4 dak1 gam3 zau1 dou3 zan1 hai6 hou2 wai4 jan4 zoek6 soeng2

rows.note: Use this when the altruism is shown by being willing and happy to help others.

example.english: Ming is always happy to help new colleagues; he is truly altruistic.
example.traditional: 阿明成日主動幫新同事，真係樂於助人。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 seng4 jat6 zyu2 dung6 bong1 san1 tung4 si6 zan1 hai6 lok6 jyu1 zo6 jan4
